youtube.title: Amelia Earhart's Last Flight: What Really Happened? (Full Case File)
youtube.description:
On 2 July 1937, Amelia Earhart and navigator Fred Noonan vanished near Howland Island in the central Pacific during the last legs of her round-the-world flight. Her last confirmed messages to the Coast Guard cutter Itasca included "We must be on you but cannot see you" and "gas is running low." This documentary covers her rise to fame, the world flight in the Lockheed Electra 10E, the final leg from Lae, New Guinea, the search, and the three main theories: a crash at sea, castaways on Nikumaroro (Gardner Island), and capture by Japan.

📂 Case File #014: Amelia Earhart — full documentary
